## Email 1 — Primary (Dr. Pucher)

**Subject:** Prospective MSc applicant — Water Management & Environmental Engineering (Agricultural Engineer, Nigeria)

---

Dear Dr. Pucher,

My name is **[YOUR FULL NAME]**, and I am preparing an application for the **Master programme in Water Management and Environmental Engineering (UH 066 447)** at BOKU for the **Winter 2026/27** intake.

I hold a **B.Sc. in Agricultural and Environmental Engineering** from the **University of Ibadan**, Nigeria (graduated March 2024, CGPA 3.18/4.00). My undergraduate training included **hydrology, hydraulics, irrigation engineering, drainage engineering, soil and water conservation, and soil mechanics**, and I completed practical engineering internships involving agricultural systems design and fabrication in Nigeria.

I am particularly interested in **rural water management, irrigation and drainage systems, and the application of data analysis and modelling to water and environmental engineering**. I noticed your work on water management, treatment wetlands, and process-based modelling, and I am interested in applying similar quantitative approaches to rural and agricultural water systems.

I am writing to ask whether you are currently accepting master's students, or whether you could recommend colleagues who supervise thesis topics in these areas. I would also appreciate any guidance on whether my background is typically sufficient for direct admission to WMEE, and whether research assistant opportunities may be available for international master's students.

I have attached a one-page CV for your reference.

Thank you very much for your time.

Kind regards,

**[YOUR FULL NAME]**  
[CITY, COUNTRY]  
[YOUR PHONE]  
[YOUR EMAIL]

## Tips

- Send **Tuesday–Thursday morning** (European time).
- Attach **one-page CV PDF only** — keep email under 250 words.
- Do **not** ask for a scholarship in the first email.
- Wait **10–14 days** before one follow-up.
